title: Petition of Tennessee Gas Pipeline Company, requesting authority from the Department of Public Utilities, pursuant to G.L. c. 164, § 75C for the right to exercise the power of eminent domain under Chapter 79 of the General Laws for the right to take by eminent domain such rights-of-way, permanent easements, temporary easements or such other interests in land or other property necessary for the construction, operation, maintenance, alteration or removal of natural gas transmission pipeline, appliances, appurtenances, and other equipment situated in the Towns of Agawam and Southwick in the County of Hampden.
